name: v4_x_only_patient_grouped
description: X-only GRAPE bandwidth grid with patient-level grouped CV over the full CFP/ROI S/R feature grid.
notes: This grid retunes S, R, signal h, and variance hbar specifically for X-only VCTR.
All visits from the same subject_id are kept in the same fold.
Z is removed before support eligibility, signal bandwidth CV, variance bandwidth CV, and final fitting.
The signal bandwidth grid combines the original v1 small-h grid with the v3 near-global check.
